Cooking: 60 minutes|difficulty=1}} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Side dishes|Side dishes]] '''Rosemary garlic baked potatoes''' are a delicious side dish of baked potatoes infused with rosemary and garlic. ==Ingredients== *4 baking [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]] *4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] *2–4 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] *1 [[Cookbook:Tsp|tsp]] dried, crushed [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]] *¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] *⅛ tsp fresh ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] ==Procedure== #Heat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 400ºF (205°C). #Wash potatoes and pierce all over with fork. #Lay each potato on an individual 9-inch (23 cm) square piece of [[Cookbook:Aluminium foil|aluminum foil]] (or sized to fit potato). #Pour 1 tablespoon of olive oil on each potato. Make sure the entire potato skin is coated in oil. #Sprinkle ¼ of the chopped garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper over the entire skin of each potato. #Wrap each potato in aluminum foil. #Place foil-wrapped potatoes on [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] (to catch any leaking olive oil). #[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in oven for 1 hour. ==Notes, tips, and variations== * Sea salt or crystal salt can be used in place of table salt. Fresh, chopped rosemary can also be used.
